title: glandularia hassleriana
intro: Glandularia hassleriana, commonly known as Lobeira, is a plant species native to South America, belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of Glandularia hassleriana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The plant is also used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and gastrointestinal problems.
